items.title: Tractor Supply CEO Lawton Buys 15,600 Shares for $501,540 Amid Stock's 44% Decline
items.summary: Lawton's indirect acquisition through an Irrevocable Trust boosted his total beneficial ownership to 541,591 shares, a 3% increase in equity position. The stock has declined 44% over the past year.

items.title: The 5 Most Interesting Analyst Questions From Tractor Supply’s Q2 Earnings Call
items.summary: Tractor Supply’s second quarter results drew a positive market response, despite revenue and profit missing Wall Street expectations. Management attributed these results to pronounced weakness in discretionary and big-ticket categories during May, exacerbated by elevated fuel prices and drought conditions in key regions.
